# Hermes Agent: User FAQ & Troubleshooting Guide

### 1. Installation, Platforms & Upgrades
- **Windows Support**: Tier 1 supported via PowerShell installer (`install.ps1`). If using the embedded terminal in Web UI (`/chat`), WSL2 is recommended due to POSIX PTY requirements.
- **Docker & NAS**: Multi-arch images (`nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest`) support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi). For NAS permissions (UGOS, Synology, unRAID), set `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) environment variables.
- **Android / Termux**: Supported via `install.sh` (uses `.[termux-all]` bundle and `$TMPDIR` instead of `/tmp`).
- **Web UI & Dashboard**: Run `hermes dashboard` to open the local web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:9119` (includes browser-based Chat TUI).
- **Update Slowness**: If `hermes update` hangs on Node dependencies, it is Camofox silently downloading browser binaries in postinstall.

---

### 2. Providers, Models & Authentication
- **Local Ollama / Small Models Slow**: Small models (4B–9B) struggle with full agent tool schemas (~45 tools). Run `hermes tools` to disable unused toolsets, use faster quantizations, use 32B+ models, or set `terminal.backend: local`.
- **Local Ollama Ignored / HTTP 401**: `provider: auto` prioritizes remote environment keys (e.g., `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`). Force local by setting `provider: custom` with `base_url: http://localhost:11434` and `fallback_providers: []`.
- **Ollama Cloud 404**: Configure provider as `ollama-cloud` (uses `https://ollama.com/v1`, not `/api`).
- **Claude Pro/Max vs. API Tokens**: API keys always bill per-token. Use Claude OAuth login (`hermes login`) to use Pro/Max subscription allowances.
- **Google Gemini**: Legacy Gemini CLI OAuth (`google-gemini-cli`, `google-antigravity`) is removed. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or Vertex AI).
- **Azure AI Foundry**: Set `provider: azure-foundry` with `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` (run `hermes setup`).
- **Vision on Custom Models**: Add `supports_vision: true` under your model configuration.
- **Model Routing**: Dynamic complexity routing (`smart_model_routing`) is intentionally unsupported. Use manual `/model`, CLI flag `hermes chat -m <model>`, or configure subagents via `delegation.model`.
- **Token Usage / `/usage` on LocalAI**: Hermes sends `stream_options: {include_usage: true}` and forwards provider `extra_body` configs for OpenAI-compatible streams.
- **DeepSeek V4 Billing**: Check `agent.log` for model normalization rewrites; ensure explicit model naming in config.

---

### 3. Messaging Gateways & Channels
- **Setup Wizard**: Run `hermes gateway setup` to interactively configure Discord, Telegram, etc.
- **Telegram "Unauthorized user"**: `allowed_chats` only filters group chats. For DM user access, add your numeric user ID to `allow_from` (`TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS`), use `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`, or set `allow_all: true`. Note: `guest_mode: true` only allows @mentions in groups.
- **File & Media Delivery**:
  - *Inbound*: Small text/code files (`.txt`, `.py`) are automatically injected into prompt context; unknown files are cached.
  - *Outbound*: Generated files route to platform attachments (Matrix `m.file`, Email SMTP attachments, DingTalk Markdown `![image](url)`).
  - *MCP Images*: Tool image outputs with `MEDIA:<path>` tags are forwarded to messaging platforms (e.g. native Telegram photo).
- **Personas & Multi-Agent**:
  - *Per-Channel Personas*: Set `channel_prompts` per channel ID (Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mattermost) or use `pre_llm_call` hooks.
  - *Multi-Profile Gateways*: Run multiplexed profile gateways to isolate credentials, memory, skills, and sessions.
  - *Multi-Agent*: Use the `delegate_task` tool to launch parallel subagents (up to 3 concurrent by default).
- **Session Resets**: Crashed/interrupted sessions use `resume_pending` to preserve transcripts. Resume via `/resume` or automatic continuation. Default reset mode is `none`.

---

### 4. Memory, Skills, Tools & Architecture
- **Personality vs. Memory Files**:
  - `~/.hermes/SOUL.md`: System persona and character instructions.
  - `~/.hermes/USER.md`: User facts, identity, and profile (`target="user"`).
  - `~/.hermes/MEMORY.md`: General persistent agent knowledge.
- **Honcho Local Memory**: Update to v2026.3.30+ (`hermes update`). Injects `"local"` placeholder API key when `base_url` is localhost.
- **Custom Memory Providers**: In-tree `plugins/memory/` additions are closed. Create standalone plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC (`sync_turn`, `prefetch`, `shutdown`, optional `post_setup`).
- **Custom Tools**: Create plugins under `~/.hermes/plugins/` registering tools with `ctx.register_tool(...)` and enable via `hermes plugins enable <name>`. Built-in tools go in `tools/` and must be exposed in `toolsets.py`.
- **Context Limits**: `ContextCompressor` prunes old verbose tool outputs while keeping recent outputs within budget. Alternative strategies can implement `ContextEngine` ABC (`context.engine`).
- **Autonomy & Tool-Call Limits**: `agent.max_turns` defaults to 90 (override per session via `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`). When exhausted, the agent provides a final answer without tools. Use `/goal <task>` (Ralph loop) for cross-turn autonomous tasks (resume via `/goal resume`).
- **Telemetry & Tracing**:
  - Track skill loads/views in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json` via `/insights` or `hermes insights`.
  - View Open WebUI tool progress (SSE streaming fixed in `v2026.4.8`).
  - Enable Langfuse tracing via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.
- **Security Reporting**: Report vulnerabilities privately via GitHub Security Advisories or `security@nousresearch.com`. Run `hermes doctor` for environment diagnostics.
